description.value:
Requirement Your Rig is within 30 feet of the target.

Your Rig assists your attack, granting a flanking-like bonus even when it hasn't moved.

Your Rig fires, lunges, or braces on your cue. Make a Strike with a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. This bonus applies whether or not your Rig is positioned to flank, and whether or not it has acted this turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 5 -- no roll-option/predicate exists for "a specific companion/item is within 30 ft of the current target" generically in pf2e-source; that's positional-template territory, not a testable predicate. [RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS] for what "the Rig" being in range even means depending on the chosen pattern.
